info.title: StorePilot API
info.description: StorePilot backend contract. The 16 operations are registered in FastAPI. Copilot calls the guarded LangGraph workflow with policy RAG and the shared Data/Analytics agent. Live model stages require configured Groq credentials and a built Chroma policy index. Two product pages: Dashboard and chat Copilot. Evaluation remains backend-only. Reads and aggregates enforce creator current level <= viewer current level. Prototype Employee ID + assigned Store ID login issues JWT; IDs are not secret credentials. See docs/COPILOT_WORKFLOW_AND_TESTS.md for verification and remaining legacy test gaps.

BearerJWT.description: Planned signed JWT. Verify fixed algorithm, signature, iss/aud/iat/exp/jti, server session state, current employee assignment; fetch current level separately. Token retained in memory by frontend.

Unauthorized.description: Missing/invalid/expired/revoked JWT, invalid directory pair or changed employee assignment; generic safe error

Forbidden.description: Visible resource but current employee lacks mutation permission

NotFound.description: Resource absent or inaccessible; identical safe error shape

Conflict.description: Stale draft/version, invalid transition, changed idempotent input, or duplicate draft generation

ValidationError.description: Malformed request or unsupported identifier/filter; no raw sensitive values

Unavailable.description: Required service unavailable; no fabricated result
